1.t: All praise is for Allah, to Whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And praise be to Him in the Hereafter. He is the All-Wise, All-Aware
1.tr: Alhamdu lillaahil lazee lahoo maa fis samaawaati Wa-maa fil ardi Wa-lahul hamdu fil aakhirah; Wa-Huwal Hakeemul Khabeer

2.t: He knows whatever goes into the earth and whatever comes out of it, and whatever descends from the sky and whatever ascends into it. And He is the Most Merciful, All-Forgiving
2.tr: Ya'lamu maa yaliju fil ardi Wa-maa yakhruju minhaa Wa-maa yanzilu minas samaaa'i Wa-maa ya'ruju feehaa; Wa-Huwar Raheemul Ghafoor

3.t: The disbelievers say, “The Hour will never come to us.” Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Yes—by my Lord, the Knower of the unseen—it will certainly come to you!” Not ˹even˺ an atom’s weight is hidden from Him in the heavens or the earth; nor anything smaller or larger than that, but is ˹written˺ in a perfect Record
3.tr: Wa-qaalal lazeena kafaroo laa taateenas Saa'ah; qul balaa Wa-Rabbee lataatiyannakum 'Aalimul Ghaib; laa ya'zubu 'anhu misqaalu zarratin fis samaawaati Wa-laa fil ardi Wa-laaa asgharu min zaalika Wa-laaa akbaru illaa fee kitaabim mubeen

4.t: So He may reward those who believe and do good. It is they who will have forgiveness and an honourable provision
4.tr: Liyajziyal lazeena aamanoo Wa-'amilus saalihaat; ulaaa'ika lahum maghfiratunw Wa-rizqun kareem

5.t: As for those who strive to discredit Our revelations, it is they who will suffer the ˹worst˺ torment of agonizing pain
5.tr: Wallazeena sa'aw feee aayaatinaa mu'aajizeena ulaaa-'ika lahum 'azaabum mir rijzin aleem

6.t: Those gifted with knowledge ˹clearly˺ see that what has been revealed to you from your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ is the truth, and that it guides to the Path of the Almighty, the Praiseworthy
6.tr: Wa-yaral lazeena ootul 'ilmal lazeee unzila ilaika mir Rabbika huwal haqqa Wa-yahdeee ilaaa siraatil 'Azeezil Hameed

7.t: The disbelievers say ˹mockingly to one another˺, “Shall we show you a man who claims that when you have been utterly disintegrated you will be raised as a new creation
7.tr: Wa-qaalal lazeena kafaroo hal nadullukum 'alaa rajuliny yanabbi-'ukum izaa muzziqtum kulla mumazzaqin innakum lafee khalqin jadeed

8.t: Has he fabricated a lie against Allah or is he insane?” In fact, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are bound for torment and have strayed farthest ˹from the truth˺
8.tr: Aftaraa 'alal laahi kaziban am bihee jinnah; balil lazeena laa yu'minoona bil-Aakhirati fil'azaabi wad dalaalil ba'eed

9.t: Have they not then seen all that surrounds them of the heavens and the earth? If We willed, We could cause the earth to swallow them up, or cause ˹deadly˺ pieces of the sky to fall upon them. Surely in this is a sign for every servant who turns ˹to Allah˺
9.tr: Afalam yaraw ilaa maa baina aydeehim Wa-maa khalfahum minas samaaa'i wal-ard; in nashad nakhsif bihimul arda aw nusqit 'alaihim kisafam minas samaaa'; inna fee zaalika la-Aayatal likulli 'abdim muneeb

10.t: Indeed, We granted David a ˹great˺ privilege from Us, ˹commanding:˺ “O mountains! Echo his hymns! And the birds as well.” We made iron mouldable for him
10.tr: Wa-laqad aatainaa Daawooda minnaa fadlaien yaa-jibaalu awwibee ma'ahoo wattaira Wa-alannaa lahul hadeed

11.t: instructing: “Make full-length armour, ˹perfectly˺ balancing the links. And work righteousness ˹O family of David!˺. Indeed, I am All-Seeing of what you do.”
11.tr: Ani 'mal saabighaatinw Wa-qaddir fis sardi wa'maloo saalihan innee bimaa ta'maloona Baseer

12.t: And to Solomon ˹We subjected˺ the wind: its morning stride was a month’s journey and so was its evening stride. And We caused a stream of molten copper to flow for him, and ˹We subjected˺ some of the jinn to work under him by his Lord’s Will. And whoever of them deviated from Our command, We made them taste the torment of the blaze
12.tr: Wa-li-Sulaimaanar reeha ghuduwwuhaa shahrunw Wa-ra-waahuhaa shahrunw Wa-asalnaa lahoo 'ainal qitr; Wa-minal jinni maien ya'malu baina yadaihi bi-izni Rabbih; Wa-maien yazigh minhum 'an amrinaa nuziqhu min 'azaabis sa'eer

13.t: They made for him whatever he desired of sanctuaries, statues, basins as large as reservoirs, and cooking pots fixed ˹into the ground˺. ˹We ordered:˺ “Work gratefully, O family of David!” ˹Only˺ a few of My servants are ˹truly˺ grateful
13.tr: Ya'maloona lahoo ma yashaaa'u mim mahaareeba Wa-tamaaseela Wa-jifaanin kaljawaabi Wa-qudoorir raasiyaat; i'maloo aala Daawooda shukraa; Wa-qaleelum min 'ibaadiyash shakoor

14.t: When We decreed Solomon’s death, nothing indicated to the ˹subjected˺ jinn that he was dead except the termites eating away his staff. So when he collapsed, the jinn realized that if they had ˹really˺ known the unseen, they would not have remained in ˹such˺ humiliating servitude
14.tr: Falammaa qadainaa 'alaihil mawta ma dallahum 'alaa mawtiheee illaa daaabbatul ardi taakulu minsa-atahoo falammaa kharra tabaiyyanatil jinnu al law kaanoo ya'lamoonal ghaiba maa labisoo fil 'azaabil muheen

15.t: Indeed, there was a sign for ˹the tribe of˺ Sheba in their homeland: two orchards—one to the right and the other to the left. ˹They were told:˺ “Eat from the provision of your Lord, and be grateful to Him. ˹Yours is˺ a good land and a forgiving Lord.”
15.tr: Laqad kaana li-Saba-in fee maskanihim Aayatun jannataani 'aien yameeninw Wa-shimaalin kuloo mir rizq Rabbikum washkuroo lah; baldatun taiyyibatunw Wa-Rabbun Ghafoor

16.t: But they turned away. So We sent against them a devastating flood, and replaced their orchards with two others producing bitter fruit, fruitless bushes, and a few ˹sparse˺ thorny trees
16.tr: Fa-a'radoo fa-arsalnaa 'alaihim Sailal 'Arimi Wa-baddalnaahum bijannataihim jannataini zawaatai ukulin khamtinw Wa-aslinw Wa-shai'im min sidrin qaleel

17.t: This is how We rewarded them for their ingratitude. Would We ever punish ˹anyone in such a way˺ except the ungrateful
17.tr: Zaalika jazainaahum bimaa kafaroo Wa-hal nujaazeee illal kafoor

18.t: We had also placed between them and the cities We showered with blessings ˹many small˺ towns within sight of one another. And We set moderate travel distances in between, ˹saying,˺ “Travel between them by day and night safely.”
18.tr: Wa-ja'alnaa bainahum Wa-bainal qural latee baaraknaa feehaa quran zaahiratanw Wa-qaddamaa feehas sayr; seeroo feehaa la-yaalirya Wa-aiyaaman aamineen

19.t: But they said, “Our Lord! Make ˹the distances of˺ our journeys longer,” wronging themselves. So We reduced them to ˹cautionary˺ tales, and scattered them utterly. Surely in this are lessons for whoever is steadfast, grateful
19.tr: Faqaaloo Rabbanaa baa'id baina asfaarinaa Wa-zalamooo anfusahum faja'alnaahum ahaadeesa Wa-mazzaq-naahum kulla mumazzaq; inna fee zaalika la-Aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor

20.t: Indeed, Iblîs’ assumption about them has come true, so they ˹all˺ follow him, except a group of ˹true˺ believers
20.tr: Wa-laqad saddaq 'alaihim Ibleesu zannnabhoo fattaba'oohu illaa fareeqam minal mu'mineen

21.t: He does not have any authority over them, but ˹Our Will is˺ only to distinguish those who believe in the Hereafter from those who are in doubt about it. And your Lord is a ˹vigilant˺ Keeper over all things.”
21.tr: Wa-maa kaana lahoo 'alaihim min sultaanin illaa lina'lama maien yu-minu bil-Aakhirati mimman huwa minhaa fee shakk; Wa-Rabbuka 'alaa kulli shai'in Hafeez

22.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Call upon those you claim ˹to be divine˺ besides Allah. They do not possess ˹even˺ an atom’s weight either in the heavens or the earth, nor do they have any share in ˹governing˺ them. Nor is any of them a helper to Him.”
22.tr: Qulid 'ul lazeena za'amtum min doonil laahi laa yamlikoona misqaala zarratin fis samaawaati Wa-laa fil ardi Wa-maa lahum feehimaa min shirkinw Wa-maa lahoo minhum min zaheer

23.t: No intercession will be of any benefit with Him, except by those granted permission by Him. ˹At last,˺ when the dread ˹of Judgment Day˺ is relieved from their hearts ˹because they are permitted to intercede˺, they will ˹excitedly˺ ask ˹the angels˺, “What has your Lord ˹just˺ said?” The angels will reply, “The truth! And He is the Most High, All-Great.”
23.tr: Wa-laa tanfa'ush shafaa'atu 'indahooo illaa liman azina lah; hattaaa izaa fuzzi'a 'an quloobihim qaaloo maazaa qaala Rabbukum; qaalul haqq, Wa-Huwal 'Aliyul Kabeer

24.t: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?” Say, “Allah! Now, certainly one of our two groups is ˹rightly˺ guided; the other is clearly astray.”
24.tr: Qul maien yarzuqukum minas samaawaati wal-ardi qulil laahu Wa-innaaa aw iyyaakum la'alaa hudan aw fee dalaalim mubeen

25.t: Say, “You will not be accountable for our misdeeds, nor will we be accountable for your deeds.”
25.tr: Qul laa tus'aloona 'ammaaa ajramnaa Wa-laa nus'alu 'ammaa ta'maloon

26.t: Say, “Our Lord will gather us together, then He will judge between us with the truth. For He is the All-Knowing Judge.”
26.tr: Qul yajma'u bainanaa Rabbunaa summa yaftahu bainanaa bilhaqq; Wa-Huwal Fattaahul 'Aleem

27.t: Say, “Show me those ˹idols˺ you have joined with Him as partners. No! In fact, He ˹alone˺ is Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise.”
27.tr: Qul arooniyal lazeena alhaqtum bihee shurakaaa'a kallaa; bal Huwal Laahul 'Azeezul Hakeem

28.t: We have sent you ˹O Prophet˺ only as a deliverer of good news and a warner to all of humanity, but most people do not know
28.tr: Wa-maaa arsalnaaka illaa kaaffatal linnaasi basheeranw Wa-nazeeranw Wa-laakinna aksaran naasi laa ya'lamoon

29.t: And they ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”
29.tr: Wa-yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen

30.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “A Day has ˹already˺ been appointed for you, which you can neither delay nor advance by a ˹single˺ moment.”
30.tr: Qul lakum mee'aadu Yawmil laa tasta'khiroona 'anhu saa'atanw Wa-laa tastaqdimoon

31.t: The disbelievers vow, “We will never believe in this Quran, nor in those ˹Scriptures˺ before it.” If only you could see when the wrongdoers will be detained before their Lord, throwing blame at each other! The lowly ˹followers˺ will say to the arrogant ˹leaders˺, “Had it not been for you, we would certainly have been believers.”
31.tr: Wa-qaalal lazeena kafaroo lan nu'mina bihaazal Quraani Wa-laa billazee baina yadayh; Wa-law taraaa iziz zaalimoona mawqoofoona 'inda Rabbihim yarji'u ba'duhum ilaa ba'dinil qawla yaqoolul lazeenas tud'ifoo lillazeenas takbaroo law-laaa antum lakunnaa mu'mineen

32.t: The arrogant will respond to the lowly, “Did we ever hinder you from guidance after it came to you? In fact, you were wicked ˹on your own˺.”
32.tr: Qaalal lazeenas takbaroo lillazeenas tud'ifooo anahnu sadadnaakum 'anil hudaa ba'da iz jaaa'akum bal kuntum mujrimeen

33.t: The lowly will say to the arrogant, “No! It was your plotting by day and night—when you ordered us to disbelieve in Allah and to set up equals with Him.” They will ˹all˺ hide ˹their˺ remorse when they see the torment. And We will put shackles around the necks of the disbelievers. Will they be rewarded except for what they used to do
33.tr: Wa-qaalal lazeenastud'ifoo lillazeenas takbaroo bal makrul laili wannahaari iz ta'muroonanaaaa an nakfura billaahi Wa-naj'ala lahooo andaadaa; Wa-asarrun nadaamata lammaa ra awul 'azaab; Wa-ja'alnal aghlaala feee a'naaqil lazeena kafaroo; hal yujzawna illaa maa kaanoo ya'maloon

34.t: Whenever We sent a warner to a society, its elite would say, “We truly reject what you have been sent with.”
34.tr: Wa-maaa arsalnaa' fee qaryatim min nazeerin illaa qaala mutrafooaa innaa bimaaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon

35.t: Adding, “We are far superior ˹to the believers˺ in wealth and children, and we will never be punished.”
35.tr: Wa-qaaloo nahnu aksaru amwaalanw Wa-awlaadanw Wa-maa nahnu bimu-'azzabeen

36.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Surely ˹it is˺ my Lord ˹Who˺ gives abundant or limited provisions to whoever He wills. But most people do not know.”
36.tr: Qul inna Rabbee yabsutur rizqa limaien yashaaa'u Wa-yaqdiru Wa-laakinna aksaran naasi laa ya'lamoon

37.t: It is not your wealth or children that bring you closer to Us. But those who believe and do good—it is they who will have a multiplied reward for what they did, and they will be secure in ˹elevated˺ mansions
37.tr: Wa-maaa amwaalukum Wa-laaa awlaadukum billatee tuqarribukum 'indanaa zulfaaa illaa man aamana Wa-'amila saalihan fa-ulaaa'ika lahum jazaaa'ud di'fi bimaa 'amiloo Wa-hum fil ghurufaati aaminoon

38.t: As for those who strive to discredit Our revelations, it is they who will be confined in punishment
38.tr: Wallazeena yas'awna feee Aayaatinaa mu'aajizeena ulaaa'ika fil 'azaabi muhdaroon

39.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Surely ˹it is˺ my Lord ˹Who˺ gives abundant or limited provisions to whoever He wills of His servants. And whatever you spend in charity, He will compensate ˹you˺ for it. For He is the Best Provider.”
39.tr: Qul inna Rabbee yabsutur rizqa limai yashaaa'u min 'ibaadihee Wa-yaqdiru lah; Wa-maaa anfaqtum min shai'in fahuwa yukhlifuhoo Wa-Huwa khairur raaziqeen

40.t: And ˹consider˺ the Day He will gather them all together, and then ask the angels, “Was it you that these ˹polytheists˺ used to worship?”
40.tr: Wa-yawma yahshuruhum jamee'an summa yaqoolu lilmalaaa'ikati a-haaa'ulaaa'i iyyaakum kaanoo ya'budoon

41.t: They will say, “Glory be to You! Our loyalty is to You, not them. In fact, they ˹only˺ followed the ˹temptations of evil˺ jinn, in whom most of them had faith.”
41.tr: Qaaloo Subhaanaka Anta waliyyunaa min doonihim bal kaanoo ya'budoonal jinna aksaruhum bihim mu'minoon

42.t: So Today neither of you can benefit or protect each other. And We will say to the wrongdoers, “Taste the torment of the Fire, which you used to deny.”
42.tr: Fal-Yawma laa yamliku ba'dukum liba'din naf'anw Wa-laa darraa; Wa-naqoolu lil-lazeena zalamoo zooqoo 'azaaban Naaril latee kuntum bihaa tukazziboon

43.t: When Our clear revelations are recited to them, they say, “This is only a man who wishes to hinder you from what your forefathers used to worship.” They also say, “This ˹Quran˺ is no more than a fabricated lie.” And the disbelievers say of the truth when it has come to them, “This is nothing but pure magic.”
43.tr: Wa-izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatunaa baiyinaatin qaaloo maa haazaa illaa rajuluien yureedu aien yasuddakum 'ammaa kaana ya'budu aabaaa'ukum Wa-qaaloo maa haazaaa illaaa ifkum muftaraa; Wa-qaalal lazeena kafaroo lilhaqqi lammaa jaaa'ahum in haazaaa illaa sihrum mubeen

44.t: ˹They say so even though˺ We had never given them any scriptures to study, nor did We ever send them a warner before you ˹O Prophet˺
44.tr: Wa-maaa aatainaahum min Kutubiny yadrusoonahaa Wa-maaa arsalnaaa ilaihim qablaka min nazeer

45.t: Those ˹destroyed˺ before them denied as well—and these ˹Meccans˺ have not attained even one-tenth of what We had given their predecessors. Yet ˹when˺ they denied My messengers, how severe was My response
45.tr: Wa-kazzabal lazeena min qablihim Wa-maa balaghoo mi'shaara maaa aatainaahum fakazzaboo Rusulee; fakaifa kaana nakeer

46.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I advise you to do ˹only˺ one thing: stand up for ˹the sake of˺ Allah—individually or in pairs—then reflect. Your fellow man is not insane. He is only a warner to you before ˹the coming of˺ a severe punishment.”
46.tr: Qul innamaaa a'izukum biwaahidatin an taqoomoo lillaahi masnaa Wa-furaadaa summa tatafakkaroo; maa bisaahibikum min jinnah; in huwa illaa nazeerul lakum baina yadai 'azaabin shadeed

47.t: Say, “If I had ever asked you for a reward, you could keep it. My reward is only from Allah. And He is a Witness over all things.”
47.tr: Qul maa sa-altukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum in ajriya illaa 'alal laahi Wa-Huwa 'alaa kullin shai-in Shaheed

48.t: Say, “Surely my Lord hurls the truth ˹against falsehood˺. ˹He is˺ the Knower of all unseen.”
48.tr: Qul inna Rabbee yaqzifu bilhaqq 'Allaamul Ghuyoob

49.t: Say, “The truth has come, and falsehood will vanish, never to return.”
49.tr: Qul jaaa'al haqqu Wa-maa yubdi'ul baatilu Wa-maa yu'eed

50.t: Say, “If I am astray, the loss is only mine. And if I am guided, it is ˹only˺ because of what my Lord reveals to me. He is indeed All-Hearing, Ever Near.”
50.tr: Qul in dalaltu fainnamaaa adillu 'alaa nafsee Wa-inih tadaitu fabimaa yoohee ilaiyya Rabbee; innahoo Samee'un Qareeb

51.t: If only you could see when they will be horrified with no escape ˹on Judgment Day˺! And they will be seized from a nearby place
51.tr: Wa-law taraaa iz fazi'oo falaa fawta Wa-ukhizoo mim makaanin qareeb

52.t: They will ˹then˺ cry, “We do ˹now˺ believe in it ˹all˺.” But how could they ˹possibly˺ attain faith from a place so far-off ˹from the world˺
52.tr: Wa-qaaloo aamannaa bihee Wa-annaa lahumut tanaawushu min makaanin ba'eed

53.t: while they had already rejected it before, guessing blindly from a place ˹equally˺ far-away ˹from the Hereafter˺
53.tr: Wa-qad kafaroo bihee min qablu Wa-yaqzifoona bilghaibi min makaanin ba'eed

54.t: They will be sealed off from whatever they desire, as was done to their counterparts before. Indeed, they were ˹all˺ in alarming doubt
54.tr: Wa-heela bainahum Wa-baina maa yashtahoona kamaa fu'ila bi-ashyaa'ihim min qabl; innahum kaanoo fee shakkin mureeb
